blocks.text: Cloud computing mein security (hifazat) bari fikr hai. Hassas (sensitive) data door ke servers par rakhne se data breach (data chori ho kar bahar nikal jana) aur data zaya hone jaise khatre paida hote hain.

items: Security Challenges (hifazat ke masail): cloud providers mazboot hifazati intezamat karte hain, lekin users ko bhi apne data ki hifazat ke qadam uthane chahiye. Data breach, unauthorized access (baghair ijazat rasai) aur data zaya hone jaise masail ho sakte hain.

Security Measures (hifazati tadabeer): khatre kam karne ke liye users encryption (data ko code mein badalna), mazboot authentication (pehchan ki tasdeeq, maslan mazboot password aur two-step verification) istemal karein aur apni security policies ka baqaidagi se jaiza lein. Providers aksar data sambhalne aur mehfooz rakhne ke tools bhi dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Cloud mein apna data mehfooz rakhne ke liye user khud kaun se teen qadam utha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Encryption istemal kare, mazboot authentication (mazboot password, two-step verification) rakhe, aur apni security policies aur settings ka baqaidagi se jaiza le.

items: Khatre: data breach, unauthorized access, data loss.
Hifazat: encryption, mazboot authentication, policies ka jaiza; provider ke tools.
